segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ וְאֵלּוּ הֵן שֶׁמַּצִּילִין אוֹתָן בְּנַפְשָׁן: הָרוֹדֵף אַחַר חֲבֵירוֹ לְהׇרְגוֹ, וְאַחַר הַזָּכָר, וְאַחַר הַנַּעֲרָה הַמְאוֹרָסָה. אֲבָל הָרוֹדֵף אַחַר בְּהֵמָה, וְהַמְחַלֵּל אֶת הַשַּׁבָּת, וְעוֹבֵד עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה – אֵין מַצִּילִין אוֹתָן בְּנַפְשָׁן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «And these are the ones who are saved» from transgressing even «at» the cost of «their lives;» that is to say, these people may be killed so that they do not perform a transgression: «One who pursues another to kill him, or» pursues «a male» to sodomize him, «or» pursues «a betrothed young woman» to rape her. «But» with regard to «one who pursues an animal» to sodomize it, «or one who» seeks to «desecrate Shabbat, or» one who is going to «engage in idol worship,» they «are not saved at» the cost of «their lives.» Rather, they are forewarned not to transgress, and if they proceed to transgress after having been forewarned, they are brought to trial, and if they are found guilty, they are executed.

moves.summary: lists who may and may not be stopped at the cost of their lives

positions.claim: pursuers to murder or forbidden relations may be killed; pursuers of an animal, Shabbat violators, idolaters may not
